title: Earthy Baked Greek Corn Tacos
description: A plant-based friendly Greek dish featuring corn tortillas, baked in a Korean brass bowl, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Korean brass bowl, combine olives, artichoke hearts, feta cheese, sun dried tomatoes, parsley, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Mix well to combine all the ingredients.
Arrange 4 corn tortillas at the bottom of the bowl, overlapping them slightly.
Spoon half of the olive and artichoke mixture over the tortillas.
Repeat the layers, starting with the tortillas, then the remaining olive and artichoke mixture.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the tortillas are lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
